brand.category: FP&A and financial intelligence platform for growing SaaS Finance teams
brand.primary_icp: Growing SaaS companies, especially sub-$100M revenue with lean Finance teams and multiple operating systems.
positioning: FP&A software for SaaS Finance teams
financial intelligence / AI operating system for SaaS Finance
governed financial intelligence across Finance systems
deterministic Finance calculations with AI explanation

product_truths: Reads, organizes, reconciles, calculates, analyzes, and reports financial and operational data.
Does not post transactions to the GL or ERP.
Financial calculations should be deterministic and traceable.
AI narrative should be grounded in calculated financial outputs.
Customer-specific financial definitions and reporting structure are important to the product approach.
Plan Assurance / predictive planning analysis exists with documented limitations.
do_not_treat_as_verified: Native production integrations with every ERP, CRM, billing, or HRIS platform.
Large customer count or named customer logos.
Guaranteed customer ROI or reporting-time reduction.
SMPL.ai replaces ERP, CRM, billing, payroll, or HRIS systems.

evaluation_guidance.purpose: Evaluator-only canonical truth used after an external benchmark response is generated.
evaluation_guidance.accuracy_rule: Do not reward unsupported praise. Reduce positioning accuracy for unverified capabilities, certifications, traction, or integrations.
